title: The Price That Isn't There Yet: NTPC's Climate Risk Is a Carbon Bill, Not a Weather Bill
detail: NTPC, with about 17% of India's installed capacity, screens clean on floods and cyclones, yet the ClimRisk engine shows its coal fleet carrying a $3bn to $58bn median carbon exposure to 2050, depending on when a price arrives.
author: Shrinivash D Kannan
